description: This is a React functional component for the Home page of a Tic Tac Toe web application. It provides an introduction and navigation links to start a game or learn about the app.

methods.name: Home()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the homepage with links to start the game and about page, and logs the game start action.

methods.name: handleStart
methods.description: Event handler that logs the start game action to the audit trail when the 'Play Now' link is clicked.
